column1: # tests/standins/09.tsv: what a person produces that phase 09 reads (see tests/standin.py).
# 03 DC-5.1 (HUMAN): the signed names register, written as decisions/<date>-names-register.md and named in the Record
# column of the NAMES row of decisions/TRACKER.md, as signing a record does (03 DC-1.4). 09 FS-0.2 reads the tag keys
# from it. Its tag-key row is 03's own: agp-tier and agp-tisax-scope only, so phase 09 takes its agp-env PENDING path
# (FS-5.1 records FS-5.4 PENDING; FS-5.4 is not applicable). The commit gets its reviews/<sha>.md record, as every
# commit before 03 DC-9.1 must. Written once: a second stand-in finds the record and changes nothing.

column3:
cd "$PLATFORM_REPO_DIR" && [ -f decisions/TRACKER.md ] && { [ -f decisions/$DATE-names-register.md ] || { printf '# %s — Names register

- **Status:** accepted
- **Ids:** NAMES D1 SD-23 SD-33

| Kind | Variable or name | Value | Created in |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tag key | agp-tier, agp-tisax-scope | as named | 09 |

Test stand-in for a record signed per DC-1.4.
' "$(date -u +%F)" > decisions/$DATE-names-register.md && awk -v r="$DATE-names-register.md" 'BEGIN {FS = OFS = "|"} {k = $2; gsub(/ /, "", k); if (k == "NAMES") $4 = " " r " "} 1' decisions/TRACKER.md > decisions/TRACKER.md.new && mv decisions/TRACKER.md.new decisions/TRACKER.md && git add decisions/TRACKER.md decisions/$DATE-names-register.md && git commit -qm "DC-5.1 names register record" && c=$(git -C "$PLATFORM_REPO_DIR" rev-parse HEAD) && mkdir -p "$BUILD_LOG_DIR/reviews" && printf 'commit %s
reviewer: %s
date: %s
result: approved
evidence: %s-DC-5.1-review-v1
' "$c" "second human, bootstrap reviewer (test stand-in)" "$(date -u +%F)" "$(date -u +%F)" > "$BUILD_LOG_DIR/reviews/$c.md" && { git push -q origin HEAD:main 2>/dev/null || true; }; }; }
